data.narrative:
Tandem PV is a Series A climate and energy technology company founded by Colin Bailie and Chris Eberspacher. The company has raised approximately $87M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a broader Climate & Energy comp universe of nine private peers (including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen) and one public comparable (LNZA), though narrow-filter peer matching proved insufficient for robust multiples-based analysis.

Given data constraints, the valuation relies on stage-progression methodology. Using the $87M total raised as a proxy for post-money value, a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement yields an implied valuation of $174M. This single-method approach generates a triangulated range of $148M to $200M, with a median of $174M.

The primary limitation is the absence of sufficiently similar same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow Climate & Energy frontier-tech space. A peer-median cross-check would require at least three datapoints at comparable valuation tiers; the current peer set does not satisfy this threshold. Consequently, reliance on stage-progression alone carries execution risk. Key uncertainties include the sustainability of the 2.0x multiplier given sector maturity, competitive positioning relative to the broader comp set, and capital efficiency post-Series A. The $148M–$200M range should be stress-tested against IRR thresholds and follow-on financing dynamics as additional data emerges.
